title: Reading Charts & KPI Dashboards
description: Practice interpreting common chart types, spotting misleading visuals, and extracting key insights from business dashboards.

interactions.prompt: A bar chart shows Shopify store monthly revenue: Jan $12K, Feb $14K, Mar $13K, Apr $19K, May $18K. What's the key takeaway?

options.text: Revenue steadily increased every single month
April saw a significant jump, but May dipped slightly
Revenue was flat across all five months
The business is declining and needs intervention

interactions.prompt: A pie chart shows Nike's Q3 revenue by region: North America 42%, EMEA 27%, Greater China 16%, APLA 15%. Which insight matters most for strategy?

options.text: All regions contribute equally to revenue
North America alone drives nearly half of all revenue
China is Nike's largest growth market by revenue share
EMEA and APLA combined are negligible

interactions.prompt: When a chart's Y-axis starts at 95 instead of 0, small differences in data appear ____, which can mislead the viewer.

options.text: Dramatically larger than they really are
Smaller and less significant
Exactly proportional to the actual values
Irrelevant to the overall trend

interactions.prompt: Your CEO asks for a single chart showing how Slack's daily active users changed over 12 months alongside monthly churn rate. Which chart type best serves both metrics?

options.text: A stacked bar chart with both metrics on one axis
A dual-axis line chart with separate Y-axes
Two separate pie charts, one per metric
A single pie chart combining both metrics

interactions.prompt: A dashboard shows HubSpot's website traffic up 30% but lead conversion rate dropped from 4.2% to 2.8%. You can only investigate one issue first. What do you prioritize?

options.text: Celebrate the traffic increase and report it to leadership
Investigate why conversion rate dropped despite more traffic
Ignore conversion rate since total leads probably increased
Redesign the entire dashboard to hide the conversion drop

interactions.prompt: Rank these KPI dashboard elements from MOST to LEAST important when presenting Spotify's quarterly performance to investors.

options.text: Average color scheme rating from the design team
Monthly active users trend over the quarter
Revenue per user compared to prior quarter
Number of new podcast titles added this quarter

interactions.prompt: Rank these red flags from MOST to LEAST likely to indicate a misleading chart in a competitor's earnings presentation.

options.text: Y-axis is truncated, starting well above zero
Chart uses consistent time intervals on X-axis
3D effects make bar sizes visually distorted
Unfavorable quarters are omitted from the timeline

interactions.prompt: Now you discover the traffic spike was caused by a bot attack, not real users. The dashboard's traffic KPI is meaningless. What should you recommend first?

options.text: Keep reporting the inflated traffic numbers anyway
Filter out bot traffic and re-baseline all dashboard metrics
Delete the traffic KPI permanently from all dashboards
Switch from a line chart to a pie chart

interactions.priorContext: Earlier you analyzed HubSpot's dashboard showing 30% traffic growth with declining conversion. You chose to investigate the conversion drop. Now new information reveals the traffic data itself was corrupted by bots.
